title: Sunny and the Whispering Ferns | Bedtime Story
description: Join Sunny the sweet little quokka as she discovers a quiet fernery where the night breeze carries the softest secrets. A gentle bedtime story from Sunny's Little Bedtime Stories, perfect for settling little ones into sleep.
narration:
As the sun dipped low behind the gum trees, the whole bush turned the colour of honey. Little Sunny, a soft and round three-year-old quokka with the sweetest smile, padded along the mossy path on her tiny round paws.

Tonight, her path led somewhere new. Between two silver-barked trees, a fernery opened up before her — a quiet, shaded place where tall ferns grew in every direction, their long green fronds curling gently toward the sky.

Sunny stepped inside very slowly, her eyes growing wide. It was cooler here, and the air smelled like rain and soft earth. The ferns were so tall they closed over her head like a gentle roof.

She stood very still and listened.

Then the night breeze came. It moved through the fernery in a long, slow breath, and all the fronds began to rustle — shhhhh, shhhhh, shhhhhhh. The ferns leaned toward each other as if they were sharing something important, a quiet secret passing from one to the next.

Sunny tilted her little ears. She couldn't quite make out the words, but she felt the ferns were whispering something kind. Something like: the night is safe, and the dark is gentle, and all is well in the bush.

She found a soft, mossy spot right in the middle of the fernery and curled up among the fronds. They draped over her like a blanket, cool and green and sweet-smelling.

And as the breeze came again — shhhhh, shhhhh, shhhhhhh — Sunny closed her eyes and let the whispering fill her dreams.

Goodnight, Sunny. Goodnight, whispering ferns. Goodnight, little one.
